content.value: A standard closed loop system is given in the following specifications: Plant: a dc motor with inertia and friction as motor load,

Controller: a P-controller with $\mathrm { K } _ { \mathrm { p } }$ gain, Feedback: unit $\mathrm { y , }$ Input: Armature voltage, Output: angular velocity. i) Determine the performance equation of the system. ii) Determine the transfer function. iii) Write down the state equation. iv) Determine the steady state output for a step input. Assume any data for designing your system.
